Physics Coaching in Ahmedabad

Classes 11 and 12 · GSEB & CBSE · English Medium · Nikol & New Naroda

Book a Free DemoCall Now

Subject Overview

About Physics at Science Guru

Physics rewards students who understand ideas rather than memorise formulas. Our Physics programme builds clarity in mechanics, electricity, magnetism, optics and modern physics step by step.

Who is it for?

Science-stream students in Classes 11 and 12 (GSEB and CBSE) who want a strong grip on concepts and numerical problem solving.

Available for: Classes 11 and 12

How we teach Physics

  • Every topic starts from the underlying idea, then moves to formulas and derivations
  • Numericals progress from basic to exam level
  • Diagrams, examples and everyday situations to make abstract ideas clear
  • Concept links between chapters so the subject feels connected

Learn from experts

Subject Overview

About Chemistry at Science Guru

Chemistry brings together physical, organic and inorganic chemistry. Our approach makes each part easier to understand, revise and apply in problems.

Who is it for?

Science-stream students in Classes 11 and 12 (GSEB and CBSE) who want clear fundamentals and confident exam writing.

Available for: Classes 11 and 12

How we teach Chemistry

  • Physical chemistry built on clear concepts and regular numerical practice
  • Organic chemistry taught through reaction logic, not rote lists
  • Inorganic chemistry organised for easier revision
  • Chapter summaries to support quick revision

About Science Guru

A coaching institute in Ahmedabad for students of Classes 10–12

Book a Free DemoCall Now

Our Story

Who we are

Science Guru is a coaching institute serving students from Classes 10 to 12 in Ahmedabad, with centres in Nikol and New Naroda.

We teach Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Science and Social Science in English medium for both GSEB and CBSE students. Our focus is simple: help students understand concepts deeply, practise regularly and walk into exams with confidence.

This is where The Story Of Success Begins🔥

Our Focus

What we focus on

Concept clarity

Understanding the idea behind every topic.

Academic support

Guidance for students throughout the year.

Board preparation

Preparation for GSEB and CBSE board exams.

Competitive preparation

Depth that supports entrance exam preparation.

Regular testing

Tests to track progress and improve.

Doubt solving

Questions are welcome, and answered.

Expert faculty

Subject specialists with years of experience.

Complete notes

Structured notes for learning and revision.
